title: Split restoration append step
statement: For every natural number $k$ and Boolean words $w,s$, one step of the split-restoration machine from its scan configuration at position $|s|$ yields the clean configuration with state $(1,\text{false})$, input head at position $\min(|s|,|w|)+1$, first work tape storing $s$, every other work tape blank, all work-tape heads at $|s|-1$, and empty output. The word stored on the first work tape in this resulting configuration is $s$ with true appended if $|s|\le |w|$, and is $s$ otherwise.
